First, note the date format given is MM-DD-YYYY: 06-20-1217.

Adding 322 days:

1217 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1217 not divisible by 4).

Days remaining in June 1217 after June 20: 30 - 20 = 10 days.  
322 - 10 = 312 days left to add.

July 1217: 31 days → 312 - 31 = 281  
August: 31 → 281 - 31 = 250  
September: 30 → 250 - 30 = 220  
October: 31 → 220 - 31 = 189  
November: 30 → 189 - 30 = 159  
December: 31 → 159 - 31 = 128  
January 1218: 31 → 128 - 31 = 97  
February 1218: 28 (1218 not divisible by 4) → 97 - 28 = 69  
March: 31 → 69 - 31 = 38  
April: 30 → 38 - 30 = 8  

Remaining 8 days into May 1218: May 8, 1218.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1218-05-08
